hna_approved_source.label: DOLA SB24-174 approved housing needs assessments (copy of 2026-10-22)

meta.note: Which state housing and land use laws apply to each county and municipality, in DOLA's own words. CDPs are unincorporated and follow their county. COHO doesn't decide whether a jurisdiction complies; DOLA does. Built by scripts/policy/build_state_housing_laws.py.

laws.name: Accessory dwelling units
laws.plain: Accessory dwelling units must be allowed wherever single-family homes are allowed.

laws.name: Minimum parking
laws.plain: No minimum parking for apartments and qualifying conversions in transit service areas (metro areas, since June 30, 2025).

laws.name: Transit-oriented communities
laws.plain: Zone for more homes near transit: a housing opportunity goal of an average 40 homes an acre in transit areas.

laws.name: Residential occupancy
laws.plain: No limit on how many people may live together based on family relationship; only health, safety or program limits.

laws.name: Housing needs assessment
laws.plain: A housing needs assessment that follows DOLA's method, sent to DOLA by December 31, 2026.

laws.name: Housing action plan
laws.plain: A housing action plan built on the needs assessment.

laws.name: Water supply element
laws.plain: A water supply element in the master plan.

laws.name: Strategic growth element
laws.plain: A strategic growth element in the master plan.

laws.name: Housing on qualifying properties
laws.plain: From December 31, 2027, housing on land owned by school districts, colleges, housing authorities, transit agencies and affordable housing nonprofits gets administrative approval.
